name: Ventspils University of Applied Sciences
summary: Coastal university of applied sciences in Ventspils; three English-taught bachelor's: Computer Science, Business Administration, Start-Up Management.

ib.text: No IB-specific page: a secondary diploma with an average of at least 60%, Maths and English above the pass mark, and English B2 shown by your EU school certificate or a test such as IELTS 5.5.

dates.label: Registration for the 2027/28 academic year opens
Application deadline for EU, EEA and Swiss citizens

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Computer basics, networks, standalone and network programming, and deeper subjects such as calculus, data structures and differential equations, with traineeships at research institutes and IT firms.
programmes.ib: Maths exam set by the university; average of at least 60% on your secondary qualification; English B2 proof unless your school certificate shows B2.

needs.note: Grade above the minimum passing grade; no IB conversion published
Grade above the minimum passing grade; plus B2 proof

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on an English test result and the university's maths exam; a motivation letter is required with the application.

programmes.name: Business Administration
programmes.about: Management, finance, public relations and customer psychology taught in English so you can start a business or take a managerial role.

needs.note: Grade above the minimum passing grade; no IB conversion published
Grade above the minimum passing grade; plus B2 proof

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on an English test result, your average secondary grade and your maths grade; a motivation letter is required.

programmes.name: Start-Up Management
programmes.about: Learning by doing in technology entrepreneurship: you start setting up your own company in the first year with mentors, leading to a professional bachelor's in business administration and the qualification Enterprise Manager.
programmes.ib: Maths and English grades above the pass mark, average of at least 60%, plus the university's entrance test and interview.

needs.note: Grade above the minimum passing grade; no IB conversion published
Grade above the minimum passing grade; plus B2 proof

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on an English test, average secondary grade, maths grade, then the university's entrance test and interview; a motivation letter is required.

notes: English-taught degrees start in the autumn (September) semester only.
EU, EEA and Swiss citizens pay a 100 euro application fee (150 for others) and a lower tuition fee than other nationalities on Start-Up Management and Computer Science.
Business Administration costs 3,500 euro a year for everyone; the Start-Up Management fee for other nationalities is 5,000 euro.
